title: Modular Onboarding, Unified Authentication & Identity Centralization
summary: This release brings a beautifully redesigned setup wizard, a centralized profile manager, and significant improvements to the login experience, making it easier and safer than ever to manage user VISAR account.

sections.title: Added & New Features
items: Launched a completely redesigned, easy-to-use Onboarding Setup Wizard featuring new visual layouts and helpful information pages.
Added the ability to register a brand-new account directly from the quick-login screen without needing to restart the application.
Integrated functional, real-time system permission requests directly into the initial setup process.
Added a helpful safety warning that alerts user if user accidentally try to close the setup wizard before finishing user configuration.

sections.title: Improvements & System Redux
items: Moved all personal account settings (like user Username, Nickname, and Email) out of the general settings and into a newly designed, easily scrollable Profile Manager.
Profile changes now update instantly across the entire application the moment user switch accounts or edit user details during a live session.
Upgraded the visual design of the Identity Manager and profile dialogues to perfectly match the sleek, glass-like aesthetic of the main application.
Refreshed all icons on the main left sidebar for a sharper, more modern look, with a specific design update to the 8th sidebar icon.
Upgraded the internal security engine to handle logins and account handshakes much more smoothly across different windows.

sections.title: Fixes & Security
items: Fixed a frustrating bug where the login screen would continuously pop up in an endless loop even after successfully logging in.
Resolved an issue where clicking the profile icon could force multiple identity windows to open and stack on top of each other.
Unified how the application tracks its internal version number to prevent future update glitches and mismatched version errors.

sections.title: Removed & Deprecated
items: Completely removed the outdated legacy setup onboarding interface to make way for the new modular wizard.

notes: Version 1.6.1.0 ensures that the first steps a user takes into VISAR Edge are polished, secure, and visually stunning. By centralizing the identity controls, managing user profile is now a seamless part of the daily workflow.
